name: Steal a Sprunki
desc:
Welcome to Steal a Sprunki!

Can you build the strongest sprunki squad… or will someone steal it all?

– Buy the best sprunkies
– Sneak around and steal other players’ best units
– Rebirth to boost your grind speed
– Buy weapons to stop other players

💸SPRUNKIS EARN CASH OFFLINE! 💸

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
